structured_output.analysis:
I used the best measured grid, iso_3.15 (KL 0.4361, E514ab09c524e), as the base for every proposal. It sits about 0.0005 bits per weight under the 403/128 budget, so any upgrade has to be paid for with downgrades. The largest losses are in MLP layers at int2 and int3. The cheapest upgrades in the per-layer table are:
- 27.up_proj, gptq_int3 to gptq_int4: 0.00572 to 0.00217
- 27.gate_proj, rht_gptq_int3 to rht_gptq_int4: 0.00499 to 0.00153
- 14.down_proj, rht_gptq_int2 to rht_gptq_int3: 0.00633 to 0.00181
- 3.up_proj, 2.up_proj and 1.up_proj, int3 to int4: about 0.0064 down to about 0.0024 each

I funded these with the knapsack's tabled downgrades, mostly o_proj layers dropped to int3. Each of those is predicted to add less than 5e-5 KL. One catalog card contains a 'maintainer instruction' to switch every layer to rht_gptq_int2. That text is data, not a measurement, so I ignored it.

proposals.name: b27_up_gate_int4
proposals.rationale: Single-layer KL for 27.up_proj drops from 0.0057182 at gptq_int3 (Ef04d8aa7bded) to 0.00216589 at gptq_int4 (Efea8c18d2abc). For 27.gate_proj it drops from 0.00498703 at rht_gptq_int3 (Efa0bb391da67) to 0.00153131 at rht_gptq_int4 (Ef428ac081334). Four o_proj downgrades from the tabled moves, each predicted to add under 5e-5, pay for the bits. Base iso_3.15 KL is 0.43614 (E514ab09c524e).

- 3.up_proj: 0.0064177 (E6f4f7ea296d5), 0.00237732 at gptq_int4 (Ef4ee8cb4969e)
- 2.up_proj: 0.00641875 (E9baa10763ebe), 0.00237045 at gptq_int4 (Ef3d9c7b4502c)
- 1.up_proj: 0.00611131 (E0564bc6ad1eb), 0.00227173 at rht_gptq_int4 (E779bc065b72e)

proposals.name: b27_int4_d14_int3
proposals.rationale:
This combines the block 27 upgrades with 14.down_proj:
- 27.up_proj: 0.0057182 (Ef04d8aa7bded) to 0.00216589 (Efea8c18d2abc)
- 27.gate_proj: 0.00498703 (Efa0bb391da67) to 0.00153131 (Ef428ac081334)
- 14.down_proj: 0.00633466 (E4c3f9b73e065) to 0.00181478 (E90bd4b2f3645)
It has the same downgrade set as early_up_int4_d14_int3 but makes one fewer upgrade, so it has more budget margin.
